# KVM sandbox parameter and CLI WorkOS application

Daytona 0.218.0 adds a kvm parameter to sandbox creation in every SDK and moves CLI login to a dedicated WorkOS application.

### Features

SDK: add kvm sandbox create parameter across all SDKs

CLI: log in through the CLI's own WorkOS application when the API advertises one
